# Inkra preferences

Stored in `conf.user.json` (PR-001): Windows `%APPDATA%\Inkra\`, macOS `~/Library/Application Support/Inkra/`, Linux `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/inkra/`. Flat JSON object with dotted keys; unknown keys are preserved; writes are atomic; a corrupt file is backed up as `conf.user.json.bak-<timestamp>` (PR-003).
